BIOL 210 Course Agenda

Week 5, Sep 21-25

agenda-week5.Rmd

Reminders

  • Mastery project guidelines are now live!

    • Note that the project proposal is due Oct 10.

  • Link to in-class slides and handouts

  • Midterm Reflection is coming up – complete and meet with me by Oct 9. You can access the reflection document here. The link to my calendar is in the doc. We’ll have a 5-min meeting to discuss your responses.

  • Exam 1 material finishes this week. Exam 1 is due Oct 2, end of day. Exam 1 available here.

    • Exams are short-answer, open-note, open-book, untimed.
    • Use of internet searches not permitted.
    • Do not discuss with anyone but Angie.
    • Designed to be completed within 75 minutes for a well-prepared student.

Biology Events

  • Biology Seminar: Wendy Uhlmann (OC ’83), MS, LCGC
    “Unwinding your DNA: Genetic counseling, genetic testing, and ethical issues”, 12:10pm Fri Sep 25, Craig Lecture Hall, Pizza available.

  • Branches & Boba - STEM-ing together over Boba! Fri Sep 25, 4:30-6:00pm, Moffett II

  • Biology Fall Welcome Event: Wed Sep 30, 4:30-6:00pm with donuts and cider! Outside the Science Center Atrium (inside if rain). Yard games, professors, professors’ dogs, friendly faces – welcoming prospective/interested Biology majors especially!

  • Oberlin Shansi (http://www.shansi.org) funds learning experiences between Oberlin and partners in Asia.

    • Fellowships in India, China, Indonesia, Japan, and Vietnam. Applications due Jan 4, 2027 for summer/fall 2027 experiences.
    • AAPI Experience Grants highlight experiences and voices of AAPI communities in North America.
    • In-Asia Grants program applications open for WT and summer 2027; WT project applications due Oct 26.
